Kiran Fernandes
Senior Digital Marketing Manager | Bengaluru
kiran.fernandes866@example.com | +91 9947011604

Experienced digital marketer with a technical background in front-end development. Combines data-driven paid acquisition and organic growth strategies with hands-on content production to improve lead quality and reduce CAC. Comfortable collaborating with product and engineering teams to implement tracking and optimize funnels. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience

Helio Energy — Nov 2023 - Present
Senior Digital Marketing Manager
- Led an SEO roadmap that improved organic sessions by 48% in six months through content calendar execution and on-page optimization focused on solar product pages; Content Writing produced 36 long-form assets resulting in a 22% uplift in assisted conversions.
- Implemented technical SEO fixes with engineering, reducing crawl errors by 85% and improving indexation of priority pages, driving a 30% increase in SERP visibility for targeted keywords (Top 10).
- Launched a content-led lead nurturing flow that increased marketing qualified leads by 27% and shortened time-to-conversion by 18% through targeted blog series and gated guides; coordinated editorial calendar and Content Writing workflows.

UrbanPantry — Mar 2020 - Oct 2023
Performance Marketer
- Managed Google Ads campaigns across search and display, cutting cost-per-acquisition by 35% year-over-year while scaling monthly transactions by 2.3x through refined audience segmentation and bid strategies.
- Led SEO initiatives that increased organic revenue contribution from 12% to 34% over 18 months by optimizing category structure, internal linking, and Content Writing for high-intent recipes and product pages.
- Built HubSpot inbound funnels and lead scoring models; implemented email nurture sequences and automated workflows that improved lead-to-customer conversion rate by 19% and reduced lead response SLA by integrating CRM triggers.
- Collaborated with product and analytics teams using Jira to scope tracking requirements and launch A/B tests that improved landing page conversion rates by 14%.

GreenGrid — Jun 2018 - Feb 2020
Angular Developer
- Developed and maintained customer-facing dashboards in Angular and TypeScript, delivering a 40% faster page load time by refactoring components and optimizing change detection.
- Implemented modular TypeScript services for API integration, reducing bug reports related to data synchronization by 60% and improving developer velocity for new feature delivery.
- Coordinated feature delivery and bug triage using Jira; partnered with designers and QA to ship three major releases that increased user engagement metrics on the platform.

Projects
- Solar Savings Calculator — Built content and interactive copy for Helio Energy’s calculator tool that increased demo requests by 21%; collaborated with engineers to ensure SEO-friendly markup.
- Recipe SEO Series — Developed a 12-part Content Writing series at UrbanPantry focused on seasonal recipes, which drove a 30% rise in organic inbound traffic for targeted long-tail keywords.
